run_speech_to_text_action: run the speech to text action that transcribes audio chunks into text output
stream_text_output: stream transcription text output from an STT model server with stop command detection
has_stop_command: check if a text string is a stop or exit command for halting transcription
make_action_registry: create an action registry with the speech to text action schema and handler
review_run_speech_to_text: review the run_speech_to_text async function that feeds audio chunks to the STT model server
